---
title: "Data Cleaning Script"
format: html
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(httr)
library(rvest)
library(tibble)
```

## Join Obesity and Income Data

```{r}
obesity_income <- obesity|>
  inner_join(country_income, by="Country")
write_csv(obesity_income, 'obesity_income.csv')
```

## Plotting the Relationship between Obesity and Income

```{r}
ggplot(obesity_income, aes(x = `Median Income 2020`, y = `Obesity Rate`)) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    title = "Obesity Rate vs. Median Income 2020 by Country",
    x = "Median Income 2020 (USD)",
    y = "Obesity Rate (%)"
  ) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "red")
```

## Join Obesity and Market Price Data

```{r}
food_price <- food_price|>
  select(Country, average_price, item_name)

obesity_price <- obesity|>
  inner_join(food_price, by="Country")
write_csv(obesity_price, 'obesity_price.csv')
```

## Plot the Relationship Obesity Rate and Market Affordability

```{r}
country_obesity_price <- obesity_price|>
  group_by(Country)|>
  summarize(avg_price = round(mean(average_price, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
            avg_obesity = mean(`Obesity Rate`, na.rm = TRUE))

# Create the plot
ggplot(country_obesity_price, aes(x = avg_price, y = avg_obesity)) +
  geom_point() +  # Scatter plot
  labs(title = "Obesity Rate vs. Average Market Food Prices by Country",
       x = "Average Market Food Price (USD)",
       y = "Average Obesity Rate (%)")
```
